negative_reviews.text:
After hearing the hype about Maki and Ramen for so long I was really looking forward to trying with my husband. Well, I was very disappointed.

We ordered the chicken karaage and two ramens (one seafood, one steak). The chicken karaage came out within 60 seconds, something I find very concerning and a red flag in any restaurant. I wouldn’t even believe an excuse of “it sits out cooking ready to go”, because when I bit into my first piece it had red pieces, appearing jelly like and under cooked.

Batter was also very greasy and thick - more batter than chicken. The ramen was pretty average. Egg looked like it had sat out for a long time with a dried out yoke.

The menus and table also didn’t feel very clean. The menu actually felt sticky. Pretty disappointed and certainly won’t be back. Didn’t think it was worth what we paid.

The ramen broth was quite limited, but it was rich and really tasty. Unfortunately, the prawn tempura was probably the worst I’ve ever had—it wasn’t crispy at all, and the batter was extremely thick.

negative_reviews.author: Sophia SIU
negative_reviews.text:
I and my family members visited on last Saturday night. Not much people on that night, therefore we just needed to be wait for about 5-10 minutes for the table.

We ordered a black garlic tonkotsu ramen. We were shocked as the ramen served to us with such little amount of soup . We preferred that the ramen should be served with at least half bowel of soup.

We also ordered rainbow roll and sushi set. The food tastes good and fresh .

However, we were shocked again that they automatically adds a service charge to the bill. We enquired to the waitress and she confirmed us we have to pay the bill with service charge .

In summary, the food was fine. Instead the price shows on the menu ,please pay attention they also have 10% service charges.

negative_reviews.author: farial mahmud
negative_reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience at Maki & Ramen Meadowhall on Saturday 15 August, shortly after 6:30 pm.

We visited as a family with our very young daughter and had brought a small amount of fried chicken for her because she would not eat the restaurant food.

A staff member told us outside food was not allowed due to allergy/cross-contamination concerns. We would have completely respected the policy if it had simply been explained politely.

Instead, the staff member was rude and condescending, continued lecturing us, and made a sarcastic comparison that bringing food for our toddler was like “going to a shoe shop with shoes.”

The way we were treated made us feel singled out and uncomfortable, and honestly ruined the whole meal for us. After that interaction, we could not relax or enjoy the food at all.

The behaviour also left us wondering whether we were being treated differently from other customers.

Restaurant policies are understandable, but customers should still be treated with basic respect.

I emailed Maki & Ramen management about this on 20 August and have not received a response yet.

The food was mediocre at best, we were 3 people, we got 3 mains and 1 starter.
They did serve the food very quickly- which makes you wonder a bit, however it was basic at best for some classic dishes.

We paid around 25£ each and we will not return.
I do not and will never recommend a place that does not keep their restroom clean.

negative_reviews.author: Alan Reid
negative_reviews.text:
Greasy and lukewarm yaki soba.
Warm broth. Mediocre ramen.

negative_reviews.author: Melanie Ngai
negative_reviews.text:
I have been to this restaurant twice, with 1 week apart. Both times the service was good. Navin stood out in service, very helpful and friendly.
On my first visit, the food was disappointing. The Steak Tataki Raman had 4 thin small slices of steak and they were well done not rare, so a little chewy. The sushi rice in the volcano roll and soft shell crab roll was over cooked, they were like sticky rice, not nice at all.
2nd visit, the sushi rolls rice was as expected. We really enjoyed our food in our 2nd visit.
The chef must had an off day on our 1st visit.

negative_reviews.author: Amman Meah
negative_reviews.text: My server Navin was great, sashimi was good, tempura squid tasted like rubber. Mainly annoyed about the fact their bookings started from 3:45, I booked a table for 4pm the day before, arrived, and the restaurant was closed. Terrible work from them to accept bookings when they’re not even open.

negative_reviews.author: Randal Boyle
negative_reviews.text: Poor service, bad ramen, bad sushi and bad drinks. The place was understaffed but really isn’t worth a visit

negative_reviews.author: Shreena Soomarah
negative_reviews.text: Waited 10 minutes for someone to acknowledge we were waiting, even though we had reserved. Had to steal cutlery because nobody brought us any. No condiments on the table besides soya sauce. Tempura was thick and floury - not tempura. The only good part of the ramen was the broth and we had to wait 40 minutes for it. It soon became clear that this place has no interest in being a Japanese restaurant. If you’re into appearances and eat your maki with a fork and dip it into your ramen (as we saw) this is the place for you.  Even Wagamama or yo sushi are better. If you want a good Japanese restaurant for the same price go to Sanjugo. If you want fusion go to Uba. If you have more money than sense and need to be warned that you’ll be fined if you vape in the toilets (who does that???) this is the place for you.

While I cannot say with certainty what caused it, the fact that we both experienced the same symptoms after eating the same meal was worrying.

Overall, the combination of inattentive service, overly salty food and our experience afterwards made this a very disappointing visit.

Btw, 12.5% service charge included.
